name: Natsu Matsuri
source: Spend a festival night with your best friend in this small technical demo! There are different paths to choose, with different consequences. How would you enjoy a festival if you were back to 5th or 6th grader with your best friend?
translation: 在这个小型技术演示中与你最好的朋友度过一个节日之夜！有不同的道路可供选择，也会带来不同的后果。如果你和你最好的朋友一起回到五年级或六年级的学生，你会如何享受节日？
